title: Letter From Chekiai Agency Requesting Information Regarding Registration

page_data.en:
Fm. 8
G. 35000-4-34

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Criminal R.C.I.Y.
No. D 5681
Special Branch S. 5.
Date 20, 1 / 34）

Subject (in full) Letter from "Chekiai Agency" Requesting Information
Regarding Registration.
Made by and Forwarded by D.J. McKeown.

Sir,
I have to report having interviewed Mr. Kuangson
Young (楊光性), manager of the "Chekiai News Agency"
(世界電讯社), and having informed him that it is not
necessary to register the Agency with the Settlement
authorities. Mr. Young stated that he had already applied for
registration with the Bureau of Social Affairs.

D.J. McKeown
D. J.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事科 政治部
编号 D 5681
特务科 S. 5.
日期 1934年1月20日）

主题（全称） “浙江通讯社”来函询问有关注册事宜。
由 D.J. McKeown 撰写并转呈。

先生，
兹报告本人已会见“世界電讯社”（Chekiai News Agency）经理楊光性（Kuangson Young）先生，并告知他无需向租界当局登记该通讯社。杨先生表示，他已向上海市社会局申请注册。

D.J. McKeown
D. J.
特务科主管警官。

Shanghai Municipal Council,
SHANGHAI.

Dear Sirs,

We beg to notify you of the opening of the editorial office of the Chekiai Agency at 302 Continental Emporium. Will you be so good as to let us know the procedure for the registration of this Agency with the Municipal Council. Steps are now being taken to form a limited company.

The Agency is founded by Mr. Li Yuying, member of the Central Executive Committee of the Kuo-mintang and Dr. C. Kuangson Young, until recently Chinese Consul in London, who is now acting as Managing Director. Your immediate attention to this matter will be greatly appreciated.

Yours truly,
C. Kuangson Young.

CKY: AL
REFERRED TO
POLICE FORCE
FOR THE ACTION DIRECT
13 FEB. 1934

敬启者：

敝社谨此通知，浙江通讯社编辑部已于南京路大陆商场302室开业。恳请惠示向工部局注册该通讯社之程序。目前正着手组建一家有限公司。

本通讯社由国民党中央执行委员会委员李石曾（Li Yuying）先生及前驻伦敦中国领事、现任总经理的杨光生（C. Kuangson Young）博士共同创立。如蒙即刻关注此事，不胜感激。

此致
敬礼

C. Kuangson Young
